content.text:
This is a git-cliff configuration file used to generate CHANGELOG.md at release time. The changes rename the GitHub repo slug and refactor a hardcoded PR URL to use template variables sourced from the same static config block above.

There is no attacker-controlled input reaching any sink:
- `remote.github.owner`/`repo` are static TOML literals in this file, not runtime input.
- The template output is Markdown text emitted into a changelog file; the only interpolated dynamic values (`commit.remote.username`, `commit.remote.pr_number`) already existed pre-change and come from GitHub API metadata unchanged by this diff.
- No shell/SQL/filesystem/eval sinks; no entry points; not a validator/allowlist; no permission/gate logic; no logging of secrets.

The refactor is a cosmetic DRY improvement so the repo-rename in the same commit stays consistent.
